desc:
🐾 Welcome to Rescue Pets!
...alpha version...
Find scared and lonely pets, earn their trust, and bring them back to your cozy rescue home.

🏡HELP RESCUED PETS FIND FAMILIES TO RANK UP AND UNLOCK MORE SHELTER SLOTS!

Pets you keep can earn donations even while you’re OFFLINE— but only when they’re happy, clean, and well-fed!

🛁 Wash and care for rescued pets
🍖 Feed them and keep them happy
❤️ Keep your favorite pets or find them a loving new home
🏠 Decorate and upgrade your rescue home
🗺️ Explore new areas and discover rarer pets

Every pet deserves a second chance.
How many will you rescue?

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
